slow_memory.input: Public global/lane/packet embeddings plus 16 public phase features; no privileged actor inputs.
slow_memory.goal: Learned differentiable internal condition, held within a phase; no independent slow action likelihood.
slow_memory.gradient: Each PPO core window starts gradients at its producing event, reconstructing earlier prefix with current parameters under no_grad. Leading frames receive no duplicate PPO loss; earlier slow history remains truncated.
slow_memory.intervals: Initial explicit research choices; no claim of optimality.
slow_memory.critic: Existing asymmetric critic retained; environment return only.

comparison.measurement: Interaction and actual wall time, gradients, event/wave coverage, actual reserved/allocated CUDA and host memory. Small progress view does not replace original full evaluation.
